verdict.rationale: Delegated access through representatives, authorized providers or designees is a fair question for a tax-authority business portal, so the axis applies. However, none of the evidence documents such a rail: no accountant mandates, no authorized e-invoicing platforms, no EDI partners, no representative designation. The items are only navigation links (professional space login, e-invoicing reform page, payments, forms) with no mention of third parties acting for a company.
